name: Boundary Corner Blitz (Spags Heat)
formation: Nickel Over vs 11P Gun Trips Right

summary.motive: Manufacture an unblockable blindside corner blitz by manipulating offensive protection with an interior DE stunt while rotating the free safety into the vacated flat.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Boundary Corner Blitz) & FS (Flat Replacement Safety)
summary.whyItWorks: The offensive tackle is forced to honor the interior B-gap spike by WDE, leaving no eligible blocker to pick up the blitzing boundary cornerback.
summary.failureMode: A quick pre-snap smoke screen or boundary tunnel screen that hits before the free safety can rotate down from 12 yards depth.

beats.title: Two-High Disguise & Press Bluff
beats.text: Steve Spagnuolo presents a standard 2-high shell with boundary corner LCB pressed tight on isolated receiver X, enticing the offense to set half-slide protection right toward the Trips overload.

beats.title: The Crash & Corner Launch
beats.text: At the snap, WDE aggressively slants inside into the B-gap, pulling the LT down with him. LCB sprints off the perimeter with a free runway directly to the quarterback’s blindside.

beats.title: Safety Downhill Rotation Erases Hot Read
beats.text: The QB looks to punish the vacated corner with a quick hitch/out to X, but Free Safety (FS) is already screaming downhill into the flat window to erase the throw.

beats.title: Blindside Strip-Sack Arrival
beats.text: With the hot window replaced and the blindside tackle pinned inside by the defensive end stunt, LCB crushes the QB before the third step is complete.

relations.tell: LCB shows press alignment with no safety help over the top, then sprints downhill at snap while FS rotates down
